title: calamintha arvensis
intro: Calamintha arvensis, commonly known as lesser calamintha or wild basil, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to aid digestion and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The health benefits of Calamintha arvensis include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe the digestive system and prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. The bioactive constituents of Calamintha arvensis include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including calming digestive issues and fighting off infections.
